title: One step for a straight instruction
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a program, $c$ a machine configuration, and $i$ an instruction. If the instruction at $c$'s program counter is $i$ and $i$ is a straight instruction (one, addition, subtraction, multiplication, load, or store), then one step of $P$ from $c$ advances the program counter by one and changes the memory to the effect of $i$ on $c$'s memory.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at the configuration's program counter is i
